# AI Mindset Main Lab W26

Canonical URL: https://aimindset.org/
Language: ru
Format: landing page

Summary:
AI Mindset Main Lab W26 is a landing page for a laboratory program focused on building personal AI operating systems, AI-first workflows, assistants, agents, coaching practices, and working systems rather than studying tools in isolation.
